text:
lina: Noticing flaky behavior in mobile-sampleapp streaming after suspend/resume. Events arrive but some `data:` lines are split and later reassembled into wrong messages. repro below.
chris: repro'd on iPhone 13 simulator. looks like a chunk boundary cut inside JSON.
lina: raw receive (trimmed):

---recv---
data: {\"type\":\"msg\",\"seq\":10,\"body\":\"part1\"}\r\ndata: {\"type\":\"msg\",\"seq\":11,\"body\":\"par\"}\r\n---recv end---
next chunk:

data: \"t2\"}\r\n
results: seq11.body becomes \"par\"\n\"t2\" — busted.
peter: that implies our reassembly assumes `data:` lines always terminate per TCP write. proxies/sockets can coalesce/split arbitrarily.
chris: what proxy chain? mobile -> fastly -> edge-proxy -> redwood. fastly tends to buffer.
ops-bot: FYI incident created: INC-2026-4411 (link: https://goto/inc/4411).
qa: quick idea: emit `event: fragment\ndata: <hex-checksum>\n\n` when a `data:` line is incomplete so client can track which fragments belong together.
lina: I like a lighter approach: don't auto-join on parse if previous message didn't end with blank line. instead emit an "incomplete" event payload that apps can choose to join. minimal server change.
peter: server-side change sketch:
```
// pseudo
onSocketClose() {
  if (currentDataLine && !dataLineTerminated) {
    emit("event: _incomplete\ndata: " + base64(currentDataLine) + "\n\n");
  }
}
```

chris: SDKs need parity: JS currently concatenates partial buffers; mobile SDK exposes onPartial callback. we should standardize on an opt-in flag `sse.partial_policy=emit_incomplete_event`.
qa: add e2e: background app 30s, then resume, assert no JSON mixing across seq IDs.
ops-bot: checklist: create staging job -> run sampleapp e2e -> add header metrics for fragment count. (task: https://goto/tasks/fragment-metrics)
lina: also adding short heartbeat `event: hb\ndata: ping\n\n` every 12s reduces long pauses being treated as EOF by Fastly.
peter: note: avoid extra cost on hosted clients; make heartbeat configurable per-route.
chris: I'll make a small patch in runtime parser and open a PR. tagging @peter for review on protocol bits.
qa: will write the e2e and attach CI job. will try to reproduce on fastly staging and with local `curl --http1.1 --no-buffer`.
lina: thanks team. follow-ups: PR for runtime, SDK flag, e2e job, incident updates. posting logs to INC-2026-4411. :raised_hands:
